deviation: The draft has no requirement that a Data Processing Agreement be executed before any personal data is processed, which is a mandatory playbook position with no fallback. Without the Arcadia DPA, Arcadia lacks the contractual processor terms that data protection law requires (for example sub-processors, transfers, audit and assistance). The draft covers personal data of customers and employees.
suggested_text: 6.1 Personal Data. The Parties acknowledge that the Services involve the processing of Personal Data of Arcadia's customers and employees. Helix shall process Personal Data only on Arcadia's documented instructions and in accordance with applicable data protection law, and only as necessary to perform the Services. 6.1A Data Processing Agreement. Helix shall execute the Arcadia Data Processing Agreement before go-live and before any Personal Data is processed under this Agreement. Helix shall not access or process any Personal Data until the DPA has been signed by both Parties. In the event of conflict between this Agreement and the DPA in relation to Personal Data, the DPA shall prevail. [Clauses 6.2 to 6.6 unchanged.]
